verdict.rationale: Unstructured lets users define source-to-destination workflows through a no-code designer or the SDK/REST API, and those workflows run as processing jobs whose status, results and failed files can be monitored. This is background pipeline automation. However, the evidence only shows runs being triggered explicitly; nothing documents schedules, event-based triggers or truly autonomous recurring execution. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or cron/event-driven triggers, evidence of unattended recurring runs (e.g., new files in a source auto-processed), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
